text:
alex: Heads up — nightly evals for chat-eval showed a regression after yesterday's runtime deploy. answer_overlap dropped ~6% on redwood-v3-3b (quantized).
priya: saw that too. Is this only the canary or across all runners?
ci-bot: nightly-evals | build 4582 | redwood-v3-3b-quant | metric=answer_overlap | baseline=0.78 | current=0.73
marco: Runner logs show a lot more KV eviction happening around token 120. Could be cache policy change from #4571.
alex: paste logs:
```logs
2026-02-27T05:12:43Z runner-5 kernel: kv_cache_evict count=31 model=redwood-v3-3b-quant seq=128
2026-02-27T05:12:43Z runner-5 kernel: batch=16 latency_p90=342ms
2026-02-27T05:12:44Z quant-kernel: fallback to q4k because q8 kernel failed to allocate
```
jordan: That q8 allocation fallback landed in runtime rev 4571? I remember a memory limit tweak.
priya: Bisect started — narrowing to commits between runtime@f3a2b and runtime@e9c11. I'll post results.
ci-bot: bisect | test=chat-eval/answer_overlap | range=f3a2b..e9c11 | suspect=runtime@f9d4e (kv cache refactor)
marco: Confirming locally: rolling back f9d4e restores answer_overlap to baseline.
alex: Canary traffic is ~5% on prod. Should we pause rollout?
sam: I can pause canary and scale down to 0 if you want — running command now.
deploy-bot: action=canary_pause user=sam status=success
priya: noting this as a release blocker. Action items: (1) block full rollout, (2) open revert PR for runtime@f9d4e, (3) add integration test that simulates prefix-heavy KV behavior.
jordan: Also add a regression signal to dashboard: add answer_overlap to canary-alerts with a 3% drop threshold.
alex: I'll make the revert PR and the dashboard change. assigning to @priya for test harness tweak.
priya: ack. I'll run an expanded eval job after revert to confirm.
sam: rolling back canary model to redwood-v3-3b-fp16 to buy time.
deploy-bot: release rollback | model=redwood-v3-3b-quant -> redwood-v3-3b-fp16 | user=sam | status=initiated
alex: thanks everyone. I'll update the incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2197
marco: we should also check quant kernel memory accounting and add CI perf test that runs with seq=256.
priya: adding notes to the eval-runner issues: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/eval-runner/-/issues/342
alex: keeping this thread for triage notes. tl;dr: bisect -> runtime@f9d4e break, canary paused, rollback in progress, follow-ups assigned :thumbsup:
